question: What Is an Instrument Hook Up Drawing?
body_html:
Instrument hook up drawings are installation details that show how an instrument connects to the process or to its air and signal supply. They show the root valve, impulse tubing route, fittings, manifold, mounting support and a bill of materials, turning a P&ID symbol into a buildable arrangement.

Impulse lines need a continuous slope, commonly at least 1 in 12: Drop = Horizontal run ÷ N. Example: a 3 m run at 1 in 12 needs 3000 ÷ 12 = 250 mm of fall.
